description: Cancel/remove one of your video tasks on the generation engine by task id (from get_video_status, get_video_task_progress, get_post or list_posts). Only the caller's own task can be cancelled; a persona-scoped API key can only cancel tasks belonging to its personas. Unknown or already-finished tasks return an error. No token refund is issued by this call.

taskId.description: Engine task id of the video to cancel (taskId from get_video_status, get_video_task_progress, get_post or list_posts). Only your own task can be cancelled.

name: cancel_video_task
